'''28''' ('''twenty-eight''') is the natural number following [[27 (number)|27]] and preceding [[29 (number)|29]].

==In mathematics==
[[File:Die_Gartenlaube_(1887)_b_320_3.jpg|thumb|The number 28 depicted as 28 balls arranged in a triangular pattern with the number of layers of 7]]
[[File:Square-sum4-28.png|thumb|28 as the sum of four nonzero squares.]]

28 is a [[composite number]], a [[perfect number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000396|title=Sloane's A000396 : Perfect numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-05-31}}</ref> a [[harmonic divisor number]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sloane's A001599 : Harmonic numbers |url=https://oeis.org/A001599 |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences |publisher=OEIS Foundation}}</ref> a [[centered nonagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sloane's A060544 : Centered 9-gonal numbers |url=https://oeis.org/A060544 |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences |publisher=OEIS Foundation}}</ref> a [[hexagonal number]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sloane's A000384 : Hexagonal numbers |url=https://oeis.org/A000384 |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences |publisher=OEIS Foundation}}</ref> a [[happy number]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A007770|title=Sloane's A007770 : Happy numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-05-31}}</ref> and a [[triangular number]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sloane's A000217 : Triangular numbers |url=https://oeis.org/A000217 |access-date=2026-07-16 |website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences |publisher=OEIS Foundation}}</ref> 

28 also appears in the [[Padovan sequence]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000931|title=Sloane's A000931 : Padovan sequence|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2016-05-31}}</ref>

In [[algebraic geometry]], 28 is the number of [[bitangents of a quartic|bitangents to a general plane quartic curve]].

==In science==
28 is the fourth [[Magic number (physics)|magic number]] in physics.
